title.narrative: Strengthening Malaria Control Service Delivery and Health Systems in Guinea - Guinea (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Guinea, Malaria, Catholic Relief Services - United States Conference of Catholic Bishops (CRS Guinea)This program has the following goals: Contribuer à l’amélioration de l’état de santé de la population en réduisant de façon significative le fardeau du paludisme d’ici fin 2027.//.Contribute to improving the health of the population by significantly reducing the burden of malaria by the end of 2027.. The objectives of this program are: Réduire l’incidence du paludisme d’au moins 80% par rapport à 2022 d’ici fin 2027.//. Reduce the incidence of malaria by at least 80% compared with 2022 by the end of 2027.. Réduire le taux de mortalité liée au paludisme d’au moins 80% par rapport à 2022 by the end of 2027.//. Reduce the malaria mortality rate by at least 80% compared with 2022 by the end of 2027.. Renforcer et maintenir les capacités de gestions du programme à tous les niveaux d’ici fin 2027.//. Strengthen and maintain the programme's management capabilities at all levels by the end of 2027.
